 The reality star often channels pop culture characters, but this year, she dressed as her own child. Cara O’Bleness | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Kim Kardashian | Kevin Winter/GA/Getty Images When it comes to Halloween costumes, Kim Kardashian is one of the reigning queens of creativity. The reality television star and 2022 SI Swimsuit Issue cover model often channels pop culture characters on Oct. 31, and for Halloween this year, Kardashian has won the internet’s collective praise with her costume: yesterday, The Kardashians star posted an Instagram carousel dressed as her 13-year-old daughter, North West. 
--> When it comes to Halloween costumes, Kim Kardashian is one of the reigning queens of creativity. The reality television star and 2022 SI Swimsuit Issue cover model often channels pop culture characters on Oct. 31, and for Halloween this year, Kardashian has won the internet’s collective praise with her costume: yesterday, The Kardashians star posted an Instagram carousel dressed as her 13-year-old daughter, North West. 
 In honor of Kardashian’s costume wins year after year, we figured we’d take a look at some of her most praiseworthy looks in recent years. Take a look at just a few of the highlights below!

 2026: Dressed as her eldest daughter
--> 2026: Dressed as her eldest daughter
 Kardashian, who turns 46 today, Wednesday, Oct. 21, drew praise from friends and fans alike for the uncanny resemblance to her daughter, North. To channel her eldest child, Kardashian donned a bright blue wig, edgy black-and-white clothing, plenty of piercings and an incredibly detailed manicure.

 “I thought it was Northie for a split second 🥹❤️ twins!” SI Swimsuit legend Winnie Harlow wrote, while model Haley Baylee added, “Oh, this eats.”

 2023: Cher Horowitz from Clueless 
--> 2023: Cher Horowitz from Clueless 
 Three years ago, the All’s Fair star incorporated North into her costume, as the mother-daughter duo opted to dress as Cher Horowitz and Dionne Davenport from the 1995 hit film Clueless . Kardashian’s blonde locks were the icing on the cake of this costume.

 2022: Mystique from X-Men 
--> 2022: Mystique from X-Men 
 Just in case you don’t remember the lore surrounding this epic costume, Kardashian donned this X-Men -themed getup for Tracee Ellis Ross’s 50th birthday shindig that year—which turned out to not be a costume party , as the reality star assumed.

 2020: Carole Baskin from Tiger King 
--> 2020: Carole Baskin from Tiger King

 2019: The Flintstones and Elle Woods from Legally Blonde 
--> 2019: The Flintstones and Elle Woods from Legally Blonde
